Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ベスピン・モーターズ ヴォイド・スパイダーTHX1138</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">乗客を3名乗せることができる。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。“リアクション”として移動できる。＊移動速度＝3。または、その位置カード上から宇宙船に、あるいは宇宙船からその位置カード上に、3名までのキャラクターをフォースを使用せずに、乗り降りさせられる。</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">軽量級の密閉型シャトルで、軌道上の大型輸送艦船への連絡艇として使用される。</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Bespin Motors Void Spider THX1138</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>A lightweight enclosed shuttle used as a liaison craft to large transport ships in orbit.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>May carry 3 passengers. A permanent pilot with ability 1 is aboard. May move as a react. *Landspeed = 3. Alternatively, up to 3 characters may board or disembark between that site and a starship without using Force.</blockquote>

The Japanese text explicitly describes moving characters between the site and a starship. The original English printing says, “OR Up to 3 characters may shuttle to or from same site for free.” Both give capacity for 3 passengers, a permanent pilot with ability 1, movement as a react and the starred landspeed of 3.<ref name="japanese-face" /><ref name="english-face">[http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/bespinmotorsvoidspiderthx1.gif Original English Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 card face], [[Decipher]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021202123508im_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/bespinmotorsvoidspiderthx1.gif Internet Archive].</ref>

'''Original English counterpart game text'''
<blockquote>May carry 3 passengers. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. May move as a 'react.' *Landspeed = 3. OR Up to 3 characters may shuttle to or from same site for free.</blockquote><ref name="english-face" />

== Missing-forfeit variant ==
[[File:Japanese-ANH-Bespin-Motors-Void-Spider-THX-1138-Missing-Forfeit-PSA-137991304.jpg|thumb|center|340px|Japanese variant with a blank forfeit box.]]

The ordinary Japanese face prints forfeit 4. This variant has a blank forfeit box. The title and printed game text match the ordinary face.<ref name="japanese-face" /> The encyclopedia shows both printings in [[:File:Japanese-ANH-Bespin-Motors-Void-Spider-Encyclopedia32-source-pair.jpg|one paired photograph]].
